entries.reply:
Sorry to hear your gnome was stolen! **Yes, you'll need a police report.**

According to the **Coverage Guide**, all three tiers cover theft of an Insured Gnome from its listed Garden Location. To be reimbursed, you must file a police report and provide the report number when you file your claim. Theft is the only claim type that requires one.

The **Claims FAQ** says you can file through the GnomeGuard claims portal or by calling the claims line. You'll need:

- Your policy number
- The date you discovered the loss
- The police report number
- A brief description of what happened

If you have questions about your coverage or the claims process, just ask!
